newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - May 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - May 20.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Armed Forces plans to build an airstrip on Scarborough Shoal off the cost of Zambales to firm up the government's claim over the area, which is also being contested by China. (TODAY)

- Senator Leticia Ramos-Shanani, sister of President Fidel Ramos, resigned yesterday from her post in the ruling party, challenging other party officials running in next year's elections to follow her lead to make the selection process democratic. (CHRONICLE/STANDARD/JOURNAL)
- National Security Adviser Jose Almonte cautioned politicians against provoking China by visiting the disputed Scarborough Shoal in the South China Sea. (TIMES/INQUIRER)
- Moody's Investors Service has upgraded the rating of Philippine government bonds to Ba1 from Ba2, a level which is a step away from full investment grade. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)
- Businessmen from the Asia-Pacific rim yesterday batted for the entry of China, the Russian Federation and Taiwan into the World Trade Organisation. (STANDARD/INQUIRER)
